approach: Rewrite each always-loaded prompt so it holds only the role's job, the output points the schema does not carry, and the hard rules a check enforces. Cut text that restates the output schema, the brief (checks, catalog, defaults, banned words, READING_RULES) or the contract. Move lookup-style knowledge (forecast scoring, governance file list, plan-field examples, verdict-rule rationale, report contents) into one new on-demand file, docs/agent-reference.md. That file is not compiled in; each of the five common frames names its path. Every phrase a test or check pins stays verbatim. Then measure the sets with the existing budgets test and set the Producer and Verifier budgets to the measured largest set rounded up to the next 50. Contract and Reader budgets stay at 350 and 2000 because other tests pin those numbers outside the deliverables; their extra headroom is stated. Update the budget lines in docs/system-facts.md (a test requires it), add a test that every pointer resolves, tighten two size ratchets in lib.rs, and record before and after token counts in CHANGELOG.md.

decisions.choice: Lower BudgetSet::Producer and BudgetSet::Verifier (both 1300 today, crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs:176-177) to the measured largest set rounded up to the next multiple of 50. I expect about 950 and 1000, estimated from byte targets, not measured. Leave Contract (350) and Reader (2000) unchanged, and state their extra headroom.
decisions.reason: Producer and verifier sets, which the planner and critic also run against, shrink by roughly a quarter, so a tighter budget keeps the 'pay for additions with removals' tripwire useful. Reader stays at 2000 because the set also holds defaults.toml and the catalog, which grow with the user's defaults and are not part of this job. run_pin_tests.rs:1625 pins the literal 'of 2000 tokens' and live.rs:250 pins 350; neither file is a deliverable. No budget rises.

rejected.option: Also lower Reader and Contract and edit run_pin_tests.rs and live.rs
rejected.why: Both files are outside the expected deliverables, so the verifier would raise a scope finding; the choice is raised as a User question.

rejected.option: Keep every budget and only state the headroom
rejected.why: The job title asks to rebase the budgets; a 1300 budget over a ~930-token set leaves about 370 tokens of unreviewed room.

rejected.option: Set each budget to the exact measured size
rejected.why: The next one-line edit would break the test, and the shared frames cost several sets, so a little room is needed.

decisions.choice: Put reference knowledge in docs/agent-reference.md, read on demand with the Read tool, not compiled into the binary. Do not use include_str! on it.

A compiled-in file would have to be added to BUILD_PATHS (xtask/src/main.rs:292-303) and the CI cache key (xtask/tests/policy.rs:937-971), and would count toward the sets, defeating the purpose. rejected.why: It would count against every set's budget and need CI cache-key changes.

demonstrations.method: Run the whole suite. Entry points are the existing `check_budget` and `compose` (lib.rs:222, 142), reached through `athena_cli::wiring::capabilities()` in budgets.rs, which builds the real sets from the compiled-in prompt files. The tests are `every_role_set_is_within_its_budget`, `system_facts_budgets_match_computed`, `system_facts_drift_is_rejected` and `the_reader_headroom_rows_equal_the_budget_figures_and_name_shared_files`. The athena-context tests are the wording and ratchet tests, plus the added test `frames_name_the_reference_doc_and_it_exists`. In athena-core, `the_reading_brief_carries_the_token_headroom_of_the_reader_and_verifier_sets` (run_pin_tests.rs:1581), `shipped_verifier_prompts_have_no_verdict_rule_conflict` and `deleting_the_commands_instruction_names_the_missing_field` (verify.rs) also run. The athena-cli `mirrors` test target runs the PromptStructure rule. No double is involved: the prompt files and budgets are the real ones, and `include_str!` injects them. The full run takes 9 to 11 minutes. Targeted reruns: `cargo test -p athena-context`, `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets`, `cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors`, `cargo test -p athena-core --lib verify`.
